title: Universo → seleção → quebras
use: Macro to micro: time of the full find, time of the refined selection, then 2–4 category breaks of that selection. Two dims keep the 3-row layout; three or four add a second bar row. Example: importer,exporter,market,state. Origin aliases (origin/origem/country) map to market — origin_country is not a product analyses dimension.
